scheme_name: Tripura Pension Scheme For Providing Pension To The Retired Home Guard / Women Home Guard Volunteers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Retired Home Guard or Women Home Guard Volunteer
Must have completed a minimum of 20 years of service
Retirement must be on superannuation or medical invalidation only
Applicants receiving pensions from other sources (except social pensions) are not eligible
Pension will be credited only to a bank account that the pensioner must open
benefits_summary: Pension of ₹750 per month per person.
